notes.title: The Whistle Demo Release
notes.notes:
The Whistle Demo Release

Hey everyone!

I am excited to announce that the demo version of The Whistle is finally here!
I can’t thank you enough for your support and i hope you will love the demo as much as i do. If you come across any bugs or have feedback to share, please don’t hesitate to reach out. I value your input!

Please keep in mind that the demo is just a glimpse of what’s to come and does not represent the quality of the final version. The final version will be even more haunting and immersive! I can’t wait for you to experience it in full.


- Psycho
